General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging (Unless Bulk Packed)
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Bolts, Spacers, Lock Washers and Nuts for the Front & Rear Leaf Springs
These are Hardened Grade 7 Bolts & Nuts
Does 2 Springs (Front or Rear)
NOTE: Metal Finish may vary from picture
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Bolts (Grade 7)
Qty 2 – Spacers
Qty 2 – Nuts (Grade 7)
Qty 2 – Lock Washers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
